flaws.description: Swapped the x-axis and y-axis labels so the heatmap now reads 'Region' on the x-axis and 'Year' on the y-axis, contradicting the actual layout (years on x, regions on y).
Replaced the true chart title 'Coal Rents as Percent of GDP by Region (1980-1989)' with a fabricated, unrelated title 'Renewable Energy Consumption Growth by Region (1980-1989)'.
